components.name: Avatar
components.description: A picture of a person or a thing: the image in a circle, or initials as the platform draws a contact without one: macOS's gray monogram, Windows 11's PersonPicture, or GNOME's AdwAvatar on a gradient picked from the name.

components.name: FindBar
components.description: A bar for finding text, in the platform's place for it: NSTextFinder's find bar on macOS, GtkSearchBar's bar on GNOME, a strip with a divider on Windows 11, which has none. The field, the buttons and the keys are MyGo's, in the platform's theme: a bar rebuilt outside MyGo could not say its names and its count (Find, No matches, 2 of 5, Previous, Next, Done) in MyGo's translations.

components.name: Meter
components.description: A bar showing a level, with warning and critical levels: macOS's NSLevelIndicator in green, yellow or red, Windows 11's ProgressBar in its normal, paused or error color, or GNOME's GtkLevelBar.
components.example: breeze.Meter(c, app.used, 0, app.size, &ui.MeterLevels{Warning: 0.8 * app.size, Critical: 0.95 * app.size}).Label("Disk")

components.name: Rating
components.description: A row of stars setting a rating: macOS's NSLevelIndicator of rating style, Windows 11's RatingControl with its accent stars, or GNOME Software's stars, as GNOME has no rating control. The clicks and keys are MyGo's.

components.name: Toasts
components.description: The window's toasts in the platform's look: GNOME's AdwToast pill, Windows 11's InfoBar colored by the toast's type, or on macOS, which has no toast, a panel like a notification banner.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: A tip shown while the pointer rests on an element: a small panel below it on macOS, Windows 11's ToolTip above it, or GTK's dark tooltip below it on GNOME.
